mainEntity.name: How much does interior wall painting usually cost in Denver and nearby suburbs?

acceptedAnswer.text: For most Denver-area homes, a single room often falls in the low hundreds, while whole-home projects can range much higher depending on size and prep. Wall condition, ceiling height, trim, and color changes are the biggest cost drivers.
acceptedAnswer.description: A single room is often a few hundred dollars, while whole-home interior wall painting can range from the low thousands upward depending on prep, size, and finishes.
